name: pstack-for-codex

interface.longDescription:
An unofficial Codex adaptation of Lauren Tan's pstack workflows, skills, and agents. Includes control-ui, control-cli, and deslop from Cursor's cursor-team-kit.

Run setup-pstack to register agents and choose models, then use poteto-mode to route engineering tasks through investigation, design, implementation, review, and verification playbooks.

This is a skills-only plugin that uses a local Codex executor with native subagent support. Setup requires Node.js 24.12+ and Python 3.11+. Defaults require an installed, authenticated Claude Code CLI with Opus 5.5 access as well as access to Sol 6.1 in Codex. All-Sol choices cannot satisfy steps that require a different model or model family.

Upstream attribution and licenses are preserved. See the repository for complete requirements and tested compatibility.
